senses.gloss: to walk about, to be at leisure, to enjoy one’s self.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 102a:17">Snh. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>נְטַיֵּיל בג״ע</he> we shall walk about in paradise.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:18">Tosef. Sabb. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:18">XVII</cite>), 18; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:10">Tosef. Bets. II, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00822"><he>טְרִיקְלִין</he></cite>. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 3; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to make walk. Ib. טִיַּילְתַּנִי עמך thou madest me walk by thy side.
